scripts.docs:dev: node --import tsx site/scripts/prepare.ts && vitepress dev site
scripts.docs:build: node --import tsx site/scripts/prepare.ts && vitepress build site
scripts.hooks:install: git config core.hooksPath .githooks && echo 'hooks on: pre-commit formats and lints staged files (Biome); pre-push needs the branch'"'"'s npm run pr-check stamp'
scripts.typecheck: npm --workspace ui run typecheck && npm run typecheck:site
scripts.lint:py: uv run --with fonttools --with brotli --with freetype-py --with pyyaml --with pyright pyright
